result.instructions: Tools for Farmbrite, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which animals are currently sick or quarantined, and what treatments have they had?"; "List my open tasks due this week and mark the fence repair as done."; "How much layer feed is left in inventory, and where is it stored?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Farmbrite data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run farmbrite_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run farmbrite_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run farmbrite_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. farmbrite_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: farmbrite_list_animals
tools.title: List animals
tools.description: List livestock records (name, type, tag number, gender, breed, status, weight, group, purchase/sale data). Farmbrite returns only active-status animals unless you filter by status (Sold, Deceased, Culled, Butchered, Archived...). GET /animals.

status.description: Only animals with this status (the default list is Active-type statuses only).

type.description: Only this animal type, e.g. Cattle, Sheep, Chicken.

name.description: Animals whose name contains this text.

tag_number.description: Only the animal with this tag number.

filters.description: Extra filters as {field: value}, using a field name from the records. A plain value means equals; 'op:value' applies an operator, op being one of eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, in, nin (e.g. {"created_at": "gte:2026-01-01"} or {"name": "like:Bessie"}). Farmbrite silently ignores an unknown field or invalid value, so check the result.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by, e.g. created_at.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: farmbrite_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact (customer, supplier, vendor). Nothing is emailed or sent to the contact. Creating twice makes two contacts. POST /contacts.

type.description: Contact type, e.g. Customer or Vendor (as defined in your Farmbrite account).

tools.name: farmbrite_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing contact (only the fields you pass are sent). Overwrites the previous values. PUT /contacts/{contact_id}.

tools.name: farmbrite_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task, optionally linked to an animal, equipment, plant, location or planting. May notify the assigned Farmbrite user according to your account settings. Creating twice makes two tasks. POST /tasks.

assigned_to_id.description: Farmbrite user id or the user's email address to assign the task to.

status.description: A task status defined in your account, e.g. 'To Do'.

reference_type.description: What the task is about (with reference_id).

reference_id.description: Id of the animal/equipment/plant/location/planting the task is about (a Farmbrite id string).

tools.name: farmbrite_update_task
tools.title: Update task
tools.description: WRITE: change a task (only the fields you pass are sent); set complete=true to mark it done. Overwrites previous values. PUT /tasks/{task_id}.

assigned_to_id.description: Farmbrite user id or the user's email address to assign the task to.

status.description: A task status defined in your account, e.g. 'To Do'.

tools.name: farmbrite_create_transaction
tools.title: Create transaction
tools.description: WRITE: record an income or expense transaction in the farm's books. Creating twice records it twice. POST /transactions.

amount.description: Positive amount in the account's currency.

category.description: A custom category or an IRS Schedule F key.

ref_id.description: Id of the related animal/equipment/plant/location (a Farmbrite id string).

tools.name: farmbrite_create_note
tools.title: Add note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to an animal, livestock group, field, plant type, crop planting or inventory item. Notes cannot be removed with this server. POST /{parent}/{id}/notes.

parent.description: What the note is attached to.

parent_id.description: Id of the animal, livestock group, field, plant type, crop planting or inventory type (a Farmbrite id string).

tools.name: farmbrite_add_inventory
tools.title: Add inventory
tools.description: WRITE: add stock to an inventory item in a storage location (warehouse, optionally a bin). Raises the quantity remaining; not idempotent: repeating adds again. Find ids with farmbrite_list_inventory_types, farmbrite_get_inventory_locations and farmbrite_list_warehouses. PUT /inventory_types/{id}/inventory/add.

inventory_type_id.description: Inventory type id (a Farmbrite id string).

warehouse_id.description: Storage location (warehouse) id (a Farmbrite id string).

adjustment.description: Quantity to add (positive, in the item's unit).

bin_id.description: Bin id inside the warehouse (a Farmbrite id string).

tools.name: farmbrite_remove_inventory
tools.title: Remove inventory
tools.description: WRITE: take stock out of an inventory item in a storage location (use, loss, sale). Lowers the quantity remaining; not idempotent: repeating removes again. It cannot be undone with this server except by adding stock back. PUT /inventory_types/{id}/inventory/remove.

inventory_type_id.description: Inventory type id (a Farmbrite id string).

warehouse_id.description: Storage location (warehouse) id (a Farmbrite id string).

adjustment.description: Quantity to remove (positive, in the item's unit).

bin_id.description: Bin id inside the warehouse (a Farmbrite id string).

order_id.description: Order id the stock was used for (a Farmbrite id string).

tools.name: farmbrite_create_order
tools.title: Create order
tools.description: WRITE: create a sales order with line items (status defaults to Draft and payment_status to Due unless you set them; memo is internal, note is customer-facing). Farmbrite may email the customer or generate an invoice depending on the account's settings and the status chosen; the API reference does not say, so use Draft unless the user asks otherwise and only pass email when told to. Orders are entered as back-office orders (is_admin). Creating twice makes two orders. POST /orders.

contact_id.description: Existing contact id for the customer (a Farmbrite id string).

memo.description: Internal memo, not shown to the customer.

note.description: A message for the CUSTOMER associated with the order (Farmbrite's customer-facing note). Only set it when the user wants the customer to read it; use memo for internal text.

tools.name: farmbrite_update_order
tools.title: Update order status
tools.description: WRITE: change an order's status and/or payment status (for example mark it Paid or Delivered). Farmbrite may send customer notifications on some status changes, depending on the account settings. PUT /orders/{order_id}.

tools.name: farmbrite_create_animal
tools.title: Create animal
tools.description: WRITE: add an animal (or a group when is_group=true with group_qty) to the herd. type (e.g. Cattle, Sheep) and status are required. Creating twice makes two animals. POST /animals.

type.description: Animal type, e.g. Cattle, Sheep, Goat, Chicken or a custom type.

mother_id.description: Mother animal id (a Farmbrite id string).

father_id.description: Father animal id (a Farmbrite id string).

death_date.description: Required when status is Butchered, Culled or Deceased.

is_group.description: true to add a group of identical animals.

group_qty.description: Head count when is_group is true.

tools.name: farmbrite_update_animal
tools.title: Update animal
tools.description: WRITE: change an animal's fields (only the fields you pass are sent), including its status (Sold, Deceased, Culled...). Statuses Butchered, Culled and Deceased need death_date. Overwrites previous values. PUT /animals/{animal_id}.

mother_id.description: Mother animal id (a Farmbrite id string).

father_id.description: Father animal id (a Farmbrite id string).

tools.name: farmbrite_add_animal_measurement
tools.title: Add animal measurement
tools.description: WRITE: record a measurement for one animal (weight, height, temperature, condition score, fecal egg count). Adds a record each time. POST /animals/{animal_id}/measurements.

tools.name: farmbrite_create_feeding
tools.title: Record feeding
tools.description: WRITE: record a feeding for an animal or livestock group. Either name the feed type, or give inventory_id + inventory_location_id to draw it from inventory (which lowers that inventory's quantity). Adds a record each time. POST /{animals|livestock_groups}/{id}/feedings.

parent_id.description: Animal or livestock group id (a Farmbrite id string).

type.description: Feed type, when not drawing from inventory.

inventory_id.description: Inventory type id the feed comes from (a Farmbrite id string).

inventory_location_id.description: Inventory location id (from farmbrite_get_inventory_locations) (a Farmbrite id string).

per_head.description: true if amount is per animal.

tools.name: farmbrite_create_harvest
tools.title: Record harvest
tools.description: WRITE: record a harvest (quantity and unit) for an animal or crop planting. Adds a record each time. POST /{animals|crops}/{id}/harvests.

parent_id.description: Animal or crop planting id (a Farmbrite id string).

tools.name: farmbrite_create_treatment
tools.title: Record treatment
tools.description: WRITE: record a treatment (vaccine, dewormer, spray, fertilizer...) for an animal, livestock group, field or crop planting. Adds a record each time. POST /{animals|livestock_groups|plots|crops}/{id}/treatments.

parent_id.description: Animal, livestock group, field (plot) or crop planting id (a Farmbrite id string).

amount.description: Amount given (a number, or text with its unit such as '5 ml').
